Title: Admin Dashboard
Core scope: Governed admin entry point; aggregates without becoming business-domain authority.

Title: User Directory
Core scope: Searchable administrative user directory with role and organization context.

Title: User Access Detail
Core scope: Effective authorization is resolved from role, baseline, preset, capability, permission and governed context.

Title: Organization Administration
Core scope: Organization administration and contextual authorization; membership is not ownership.

Title: Content & Public Communication
Core scope: Static public content and Announcement/Promotion lifecycle/configuration where M09/applicable domain owns administration; discovery remains M11.

Title: Moderation Operations
Core scope: Administrative moderation surface. Review, Escalate and Manual Correction remain distinct; source domain keeps business truth.

Title: Learning Administration
Core scope: Governed Learning administration; M04 remains Learning authority.

Title: Commercial Administration
Core scope: Governed commercial administration; M14 remains commercial authority.

Title: Bank Master Administration
Core scope: Bank Master administrative surface. M07 remains DBR/KPR business authority; WIRE-08 governs administration/authorization boundary.

Title: System Configuration
Core scope: M09 System Configuration; current Core API evidence is GET /admin/config/system and PUT /admin/config/system. Authorization is M10.
State coverage: Loading; Empty; Validation; Error / retry; Denied; Success

Title: Role Catalogue
Core scope: Role is actor grouping, not a permission/capability.

Title: Permission Catalogue
Core scope: Permission identity is (module_code, action_code); full catalogue is searchable/paginated rather than squeezed into one screen.

Title: Role Permission Matrix
Core scope: Complete governed M10 baseline is represented through a scalable matrix; all 11 canonical rows are available, with scope and editability.

Title: Permission Preset Management
Core scope: Optional role-targeted preset; never a new role and never outside target-role baseline.
State coverage: Loading; Empty; Validation; Denied; Error / retry

Title: Permission Preset Assignment
Core scope: Optional zero-or-one active preset; target-role compatibility; mismatch fails closed; assignment does not change role.

Title: Effective Authorization Review
Core scope: Explicit authorization resolution chain with progressive disclosure.
State coverage: Loading; Protected non-existence; Denied; Error / retry

Title: Administrative Review & Correction
Core scope: Operational review, escalation and manual correction with provenance; domain authority remains source-owned.

Title: Audit Log & Administrative Export
Core scope: Audit/provenance view and governed Administrative Export. Export is Superadmin-only where source evidence requires it.

Title: Notification Template / Content Configuration
Core scope: Controlled M09 semantic surface for Notification Template/Content Configuration; exact current endpoint/storage contract is not invented.

Title: Admin Action Authorization Review
Core scope: Cross-module action review: authorization only; business-domain mutation stays with the owning module.
State coverage: Loading; Protected non-existence; Denied; Error / retry
